experiences.description: The 15th century Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil - one of the most significant Hindu temples in Sri Lanka - showcases the colourful grandeur of Dravidian architecture.
Spend some quality time with baby turtles and support a project that’s dedicated to study, care for and protect Sri Lanka’s turtle species.
If you don't fancy getting in the water, a glass bottom boat is the best way to witness the wonders of underwater life.
Dive down to a calm undersea world where over 60 species of corals, 170 species of reef fish and other marine life thrive.
Step into this old British church and step back in time to 1878. The period interior remains mostly unchanged, even the views outside.
Take a kayak out on the tranquil castlereagh Reservoir surrounded by high mountains; and enjoy the breathtaking scenery and a sense of serenity.
Climb the holy mountain of Adam’s Peak to watch the sunrise and the incredible sight of its triangular shadow falling across the sky.
Enjoy a leisurely ride on a traditional canoe called catamaran on the tranquil Habarana Lake, and watch fishermen and the kingfishers at work.
Explore the 10,000 hectares of land home to elephants and other wildlife on an exciting game drive, early morning or late evening.
